sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_mood_packs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_built_in" IN (0, 1)), "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_moods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "mood_pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES moment_mood_packs (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("mood_pack_id", "key"), UNIQUE ("mood_pack_id", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_tone_packs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_built_in" IN (0, 1)), "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_tones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "tone_pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES moment_tone_packs (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "light_color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "dark_color_hex" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("tone_pack_id", "key"), UNIQUE ("tone_pack_id", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "cover_asset_id" TEXT NULL, "mood_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES moment_moods (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "moment_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "location_name" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "is_hidden_from_widget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden_from_widget" IN (0, 1)), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_locked" IN (0, 1)), "is_sensitive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sensitive" IN (0, 1)), "tone_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES moment_tones (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "moment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES moments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_encrypted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_encrypted" IN (0, 1)), "encryption_version" INTEGER NULL, "checksum" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NULL, "group_key" TEXT NULL, "usage_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_tag_links" ("moment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES moments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES moment_tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("moment_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "cover_asset_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "is_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_locked" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_collection_items" ("collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES moment_collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "moment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES moments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collection_id", "moment_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_widget_configs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "fixed_moment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES moments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "exclude_sensitive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("exclude_sensitive" IN (0, 1)), "exclude_hidden_from_widget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("exclude_hidden_from_widget" IN (0, 1)), "include_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("include_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_themes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_built_in" IN (0, 1)), "light_colors" TEXT NOT NULL, "dark_colors" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
